homepage.hero.line1.message: Local-first CLI for analyzing, evaluating, and optimizing LLM prompts

homepage.hero.line2.message: Secure offline pipeline that never uploads prompt contents

homepage.features.cli.desc.message: Inspect local prompt execution logs to catch missing sections or forbidden terms before release.

homepage.features.eval.desc.message: Collect samples from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and local providers while tracking schema fit, latency, and cost.

homepage.features.report.desc.message: Produce Markdown/JSON summaries with scores, token usage, and suggested fixes so PRs include reproducible evidence.
